css: .bulk{font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#edf2f8;background:#101722;border:1px solid #2c394c;border-radius:16px;padding:16px;min-width:0}.bulk header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:end;flex-wrap:wrap}.bulk h2{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:22px}.eyebrow{margin:0;color:#8fa2bc;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.13em}.selection{color:#b6c4d8;font-size:12px}.toolbar{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:14px 0 8px}.toolbar select,.toolbar button{background:#182231;color:#edf2f8;border:1px solid #394b64;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px;font:inherit}.toolbar button{cursor:pointer}.toolbar button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}.message{min-height:18px;color:#9fb2ca;font-size:11px}.rows{display:grid;gap:6px}.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,2fr) minmax(80px,1fr) minmax(70px,.7fr);gap:9px;align-items:center;background:#151e2b;border:1px solid #2b394d;border-radius:9px;padding:9px;font-size:12px}.row strong{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.row .status{text-transform:uppercase;font-size:10px;color:#b3c2d6}.row input{width:17px;height:17px}@media(max-width:640px){.row{grid-template-columns:auto 1fr}.row strong{grid-column:2}.row span{grid-column:2}.toolbar>*{flex:1 1 120px}}
js: let snapshot=null;const selectedSet=()=>new Set((api.getState('selectedTaskIds')||[]).map(String));const render=()=>{const tasks=api.getState('tasks')||[],selected=selectedSet();root.querySelector('[data-selection]').textContent=selected.size+' selected';const host=root.querySelector('[data-tasks]');host.innerHTML='';tasks.forEach(t=>{const row=document.createElement('label');row.className='row';const cb=document.createElement('input');cb.type='checkbox';cb.checked=selected.has(String(t.id));cb.addEventListener('change',()=>{const next=selectedSet();cb.checked?next.add(String(t.id)):next.delete(String(t.id));const ids=tasks.filter(x=>next.has(String(x.id))).map(x=>x.id);api.setState('selectedTaskIds',ids);});const title=document.createElement('strong');title.textContent=t.title;const owner=document.createElement('span');owner.textContent=t.owner||'Unassigned';const status=document.createElement('span');status.className='status';status.textContent=t.status||'Todo';row.append(cb,title,owner,status);host.appendChild(row);});};root.querySelector('[data-apply]').addEventListener('click',()=>{const chosen=selectedSet(),status=root.querySelector('[data-bulk-status]').value;if(!chosen.size){root.querySelector('[data-message]').textContent='Select at least one task.';return;}const tasks=(api.getState('tasks')||[]).map(t=>chosen.has(String(t.id))?Object.assign({},t,{status}):t);api.setState('tasks',tasks);root.querySelector('[data-message]').textContent='Updated '+chosen.size+' task'+(chosen.size===1?'':'s')+' to '+status+'.';api.log(5,'Bulk status applied: '+status);});root.querySelector('[data-save]').addEventListener('click',()=>{snapshot=api.cloneState();root.querySelector('[data-restore]').disabled=false;root.querySelector('[data-message]').textContent='Snapshot saved.';api.log(5,'Snapshot saved');});root.querySelector('[data-restore]').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!snapshot)return;api.replaceState(snapshot);root.querySelector('[data-message]').textContent='Snapshot restored.';api.log(5,'Snapshot restored');});render();const unsubscribe=api.subscribe(render);
